name: aico-vscode-panel
description: The webview half of the aico VS Code extension. Built separately from the extension host code because it targets a browser, not Node.
comment:types: React and its types are deliberately absent. They resolve from the repository root, which is where `shared/ui` and `web/src` resolve them too — and a second copy of @types/react here is not a duplicate but a *conflict*: pinning 18 against the root's 19 made every shared component stop being a valid JSX element, with an error naming `bigint` and nothing else.
